system.name: ALTS AI Powered Interview Assistant
system.tagline: Practice and prepare for your job interview in 4 simple rounds

questionSets.description: Questions are dynamically calibrated from Easy to Hard across all rounds.

dossier.title: Your Interview Score & Performance Report
dossier.description: Your interview score card, detailed breakdown, and feedback are ready to review.

rounds.title: Round 1: Math & Logical Reasoning
rounds.description: Multiple-choice questions testing math, logical thinking, patterns, and quick problem-solving.

rounds.title: Round 2: Group Discussion (GD)
rounds.description: Speak or type your thoughts on a given topic. Express clear ideas, pros, cons, and a final conclusion.

rounds.title: Round 3: Coding & Technical
rounds.description: Write and run code in Python, C, or Java to solve programming and data structure problems.

rounds.title: Round 4: HR & Personal Interview
rounds.description: Voice or text interview answering common HR questions about yourself, your goals, and teamwork.

securityGuidelines.title: Tab Switching
securityGuidelines.detail: Switching tabs or windows during an active test will be flagged.

securityGuidelines.title: Shortcuts & Inspection
securityGuidelines.detail: Right-click and dev-tool keys are disabled inside assessment rounds.

securityGuidelines.title: Single Continuous Session
securityGuidelines.detail: Complete all 4 rounds in sequence for the overall composite rating.

securityGuidelines.title: Adaptive Scoring
securityGuidelines.detail: Each round holds 100 marks (400 total) with weighted evaluation.

securityGuidelines.title: Set Anti-Repetition
securityGuidelines.detail: Your next interview attempt will automatically cycle to a fresh non-repeating set.

securityGuidelines.title: Final Performance Report
securityGuidelines.detail: An analytics card with individual round breakdowns is generated at the end.
